caption_L1: This bar plot is named U.S. manufacturing shipments e-commerce value from 2003 to 2018 , by sector (in millions U.S. dollars). A linear scale of range 0 to 800,000 can be seen on the x-axis, labeled 2017. A categorical scale starting with Apparel manufacturing and ending with Wood product manufacturing can be found on the y-axis, labeled machinery manufacturing.
caption_L2L3: Transportation equipment manufacture had the greatest value over the time frame covered. Food manufacture had the second greatest value although this was roughly three quarters of the value of transportation equipment manufacture. All other sectors covered by the chart were less than half the value of food manufacture.
